thread:
Maya: Quick question — where are the canonical audit dumps in S3 and which column in the psql view maps to the actor/principal? Need to answer a support ticket about 'who did what' and also confirm retention for raw vs redacted logs. Also who is allowed to run an ad-hoc pull?
Liam: s3 path is s3://redwood-audit/ingest/parquet/YYYY=.../ (daily partitions). Files are Parquet with the schema in the repo under infra/audit/schemas/parquet_audit_v2.yaml. The psql materialized view is audit_events_v2. Actor maps to `actor_principal` (nullable string).
Oliver: To add on perms: only members of the eng-security and oncall-sre groups can request exports. There is an approval step in the audit-exporter service — it requires a ticket id and an explicit approval from a security lead. We avoid raw exports unless absolutely necessary.
Nina: Retention is: raw, unredacted parquet kept for 90 days; redacted, queryable views kept for 3 years by default. For exports we only provide redacted CSVs unless legal/PSO sign-off for longer retention.
Sam: Example psql view snippet (from infra repo) — you can use this to point support to the exact column names:
```sql
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW public.audit_events_v2 AS
SELECT
  id,
  event_time,
  actor_principal AS actor,
  action,
  target_resource,
  metadata->>'ip' AS ip_address,
  CASE WHEN metadata ? 'pii' THEN true ELSE false END AS contains_pii
FROM parquet_table('s3://redwood-audit/ingest/parquet/');
```
Maya: helpful, thanks. For the approval flow — is there a template message we should copy into the ticket to get a faster approval?
Oliver: yes — use the template at docs/internal/security/export-requests.md. Must include justification, data ranges, and whether downstream team can accept redacted-only output. If PII flagged, you must attach a remediation plan.
AuditBot: Reminder — export requests older than 48h without a security approval will be auto-cancelled per policy SEC-EXPORT-2025. Link: https://redwood.internal/security/policies/sec-export-2025
Nina: Also tag @oncall-sre in the ticket for urgency. If support needs the exact column for 'who' quickly, point them to `actor_principal` and `actor_email` (email exists only for oauth logins).
Maya: Great. I'll reply to the support ticket with the path, view column names, retention, and the template link. If anyone wants to add a snippet or correct wording, ping me. :thumbsup:
